title: Deliciu V2 Blackberry Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Blackberry Lime Nic Salt offers a juicy mix of rich, jammy blackberry and zesty lime, delivering a perfectly balanced fruity vape. The sweetness of juicy blackberries is enhanced by the sharp, citrusy burst of lime for a flavour combination that’s as vibrant as it is satisfying. With every puff, the smooth interplay between sweet and tangy notes creates a delightful all-day vape for those who enjoy fruity blends with a twist. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping.
